# Smoothed Moving Average

*Smoothed (Wilder) moving average, the RMA used by RSI and ATR.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Smoothed Moving Average** under **Moving averages**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `7` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Color | color | `"#673AB7"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/smma.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Smoothed Moving Average", shortTitle: "SMMA", overlay: true });
const length = input.int("Length", 7, { min: 1 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
plot(ta.rma(src, length), { title: "SMMA", color: input.color("Color", "#673AB7", { group: "Style" }) });
```
